prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all specific kinds of changes, as each category has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to measured results.
No tested kind of change has shown a clear, significant effect yet.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Add Pet Desktop Controls Cheat Sheet Screen: Adds a dedicated quick-start guide screen right after home intro showing explicit keybinds and tray icons to hide or interact with the pet. (why: Support receives multiple complaints (3 emails) from users who are confused after onboarding about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In After Pet Selection: Moves the sign-in step to occur after pet selection so users invest in picking a pet before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right after path selection; placing account creation after pet customization increases commitment.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign In Data Safety Hint: Adds an explicit hint under sign in options emphasizing that using the same account restores saved pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time Estimate and Progress: Displays estimated remaining time and progress notifications while waiting for the pet to spawn on the desktop. (why: Waiting stage takes median 201s / mean 2336s with an 81.3% pass rate, causing anxiety about whether generation stalled.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Split Screen Layout for Path Selection: Changes the choose path layout to a side-by-side split comparison of pre-made vs custom creation routes. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating users struggle to compare options in default layout.)

scores.note: Adding new screens previously reduced conversion (-1.0%) and cost is high.
Sign-in drops 27.1% of users, but flow reordering requires significant effort and carries uncertainty.
High evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in drop rate, low cost config change.
Wait info previously showed positive lift (+1.6%) and addresses extreme wait times (2336s mean).
High mean time on step (514s), but layout overhaul requires high effort and has no direct support mail evidence.
